# Vivek Anand’s blog

> Notes on software, systems, and lessons learned building them, by Vivek Anand, a software engineer from Kerai, Bihar, India, mostly working in backend development.

These posts document work with Python, Django, PostgreSQL, asynchronous systems, Raspberry Pi, and the Pagure open-source project. They were written between 2016 and 2018; technical details describe the software and practices used at the time.

## About the author

- [Personal site](https://anandvivek.in/): Personal background, interests, experience, and contact details.
